source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Once per battle, when an enemy unit's move means a [Cult Ambush](vsdata:ability/genestealer-cults.cult-ambush) marker of yours must be removed, you may use this ability if one of your models that has it is on the battlefield. Instead of removing the marker, you may move it to any point on the battlefield:

- no more than 12" from one of your models that has this ability
- more than 8" horizontally from every enemy unit

If no such point exists, the marker is removed as usual and this ability is not used up.

detail.trigger: enemy movement would remove Cult Ambush marker
detail.condition: at least one friendly model with ability on battlefield
